scope: Offline first-loss diagnostic on fixed development gold evidence-unit occurrences, not answer quality or causal proof.

stage_definitions.alignment_or_chunking: Full corpus does not contain the aligned gold unit.
stage_definitions.candidate_retrieval: Branch candidate union loses full gold coverage.
stage_definitions.fusion_ranking: Per-paper RRF top five loses full coverage.
stage_definitions.document_quota: Multi-document five-anchor allocation loses full coverage.
stage_definitions.covered: Gold unit remains fully present in rendered evidence.

note: Stages are nested; counts show the first full-coverage loss. Overlap ranks are not semantic relevance scores. Query correctness requires review. No production change.
